webster.text: Irreverent to any thing sacred; applied to persons.

more.text: Irreverent; proceeding from a contempt of sacred things, or implying it; as profane words or language; profane swearing.
Not purified or holy; allowed for common use; as a profane place.
Obscene; heathenish; tending to bring reproach on religion; as profane fables.
To put to a wrong use.

example.quote: Ware before him, by a constable, to answer for a breach of the Sabbath-day Acts, or that of profane swearing.
example.cite: James Otis, Argument Against Writs of Assistance, 1761
